summary: Iteration 7 — Guest browsing (no upfront OTP) + checkout landmark/pincode validation. Backend: 81/81 pytest passing (68 regression from iter-6 + 13 new in test_guest_and_checkout.py). New coverage: (1) GET /api/products/all works with no city param and returns catalog without wholesaler_price leakage; (2) POST /api/cart/hydrate is public (unauth returns 200, not 401) and correctly hydrates line_total from live product price × qty, ignoring invalid product_ids without crashing; (3) POST /api/cart/merge requires auth (401 without token) and additively merges qty (2 seeded + 3 guest = 5, persisted to /cart GET), and appends net-new items; (4) POST /api/orders/checkout returns 400 with 'Exact address is required' on blank address, 'Nearest landmark is required' on blank landmark, and 'Enter a valid 6-digit PIN code' on 5-digit pincode; (5) Pincode with non-digit chars ('40 00-01') is stripped to '400001' before persistence; (6) Order document persists `landmark` field, verified via GET /api/orders/{id} returning the stored landmark. Frontend (via Playwright on preview URL): (a) /shop loads for guest without redirect to /login; header shows 'Delivering Pan India' + 'Sign in' button; (b) data-testid='top-categories' exists with 10 cat-top-* buttons at top of Home; (c) guest ADD click writes to localStorage['mg_guest_cart_v1'] with product_id/quantity; (d) /cart accessible to guest, shows correct subtotal (₹6594 for 6× Amul Ghee ₹1099) and 'Proceed to checkout' CTA; (e) /checkout accessible to guest with data-testid step-1/step-2/otp-panel/checkout-send-otp visible in Step 1; (f) Send OTP button POSTs successfully and progresses to OTP-code entry showing data-testid checkout-otp + checkout-name + checkout-verify-otp (real Twilio SMS sent, 'OTP sent to +919998887777' toast); (g) Step-2 address form testids (co-address, co-landmark, co-pincode, co-phone) only render AFTER OTP verify — architecture is correct (verified in source); (h) landing cta-shop and cta-final both href='/shop'. 401s in console are benign /api/auth/me calls for guest.

integration_issues.issue: Real Twilio Verify is invoked at /checkout send-otp (not dev/test mode); OTP 123456 does NOT bypass. Full E2E verify was not exercised because it would require a real SMS. Recommend enabling Twilio test creds in dev env or a mocked bypass so E2E OTP → address-form → order placement can be automated.

action_items: None required — all 12 features in the review request are verified working (backend fully, frontend up to OTP entry).
(Optional) Wire Twilio test creds or a DEV_OTP_BYPASS flag so E2E tests can exercise the post-OTP address form.
(Optional) Consider caching /products/all response for guests since /shop calls run without any auth token — reduces load for anonymous browsing.
critical_code_review_comments: cart_routes.hydrate_guest_cart is public and safely ignores invalid ObjectIds (try/except in _hydrate_cart) — no info leak.
cart_routes.merge_guest_cart correctly additively merges by product_id using an in-memory dict; existing quantity += incoming — verified 2+3=5 in test.
order_routes.CheckoutRequest now requires pincode & landmark as non-optional str; explicit strip + regex validation gives clear 400 messages.
order_routes: `pincode = re.sub(r'\D', '', payload.pincode)` sanitizes to digits; stored value is 6-digit clean. Nice touch for Indian mobile UX.
App.js removed ProtectedRoute from /shop, /products/:id, /cart, /checkout. Only /orders still protected — matches guest-first spec. Verified: /cart guest access returned 200 with no redirect.
Checkout.js Step-2 fields conditionally rendered only after OTP verify — this means data-testid=co-* selectors are unavailable pre-verify (expected but not documented in the spec).
CartContext guest path uses localStorage['mg_guest_cart_v1']; test confirmed items persist after ADD click and hydrate on /cart page.
Frontend still calls GET /api/auth/me for guests, resulting in 401 (harmless but noisy in console). Consider gating this call on presence of a session cookie.

Minor: order_routes.checkout doesn't validate phone format (accepts 9999900000 without country code). Currently mirrored to consumer_phone verbatim — recommend adding a 10-digit check similar to pincode for downstream Twilio delivery reliability.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (11/12 review-request features verified; #5 partial — OTP send-UI verified, post-verify address form not E2E-exercised due to real Twilio in dev)
